game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern, a cavern of glowing mushrooms: the dwarf scout must handle zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Door Defense: Push to repair the supply cache while the while-loop condition stays true and zombies keep attacking.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern: a cavern of glowing mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: In Mushroom Cavern, repeat each round: Push to repair the supply cache while the while-loop condition stays true and zombies keep attacking. Each round, zombies strike the supply cache, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the door_health value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the supply cache from zombies in Mushroom Cavern: keep the door_health meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: door_health drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Door Defense
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Door Defense' (Week 4 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Mushroom Cavern'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how door_health changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against zombies in Mushroom Cavern.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while door_health > 0.
